patterns.note: Sections are often full-bleed with high-quality photography or video, creating distinct visual breaks and emphasizing the product.
Headings use a bold, modern sans-serif, often in a large scale, while supporting text and labels frequently use uppercase for emphasis and a clean, structured feel.
A minimalist monochrome base of dark greys and whites is consistently punctuated by vibrant, distinct accent colors (blue, red, green) for calls to action and key information.

The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport upon scroll. The hero section features a fixed or subtly parallaxing background video, while the overlaying text and call-to-action buttons scroll up and out of view.
Interactive content blocks, such as 'Book a test drive' or 'Charging', use a consistent pattern of a large heading with a right-aligned arrow icon to indicate further interaction or navigation.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-width background video that remains fixed or has a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic backdrop for the initial content. Overlaying text and buttons are part of the scrollable content, moving off-screen to reveal subsequent sections.
A persistent header navigation bar is implemented to stick to the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and site navigation throughout the user's journey.
Interactive elements like buttons and links consistently integrate a right-pointing arrow icon, reinforcing a sense of progression and action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with well-spaced body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for a clean, authoritative hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical spacing between full-bleed sections, with comfortable padding around content blocks.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated use of full-bleed, high-quality automotive photography and video as core design elements, creating an immersive and premium brand experience. The stark, minimalist aesthetic combined with precise typography and a consistent interactive arrow motif gives it a distinctive, modern luxury feel.
